tools.name: pypdf
tools.when_to_use: Extract text from text-based PDF research files while preserving page-level references.
tools.notes: Scanned files without a text layer require separate OCR. Spot-check layout, tables, and formulas after extraction.

tools.name: python-docx
tools.when_to_use: Read paragraphs and tables from DOCX research material.
tools.notes: Complex text boxes, comments, tracked changes, and embedded objects may require additional handling.

tools.name: edge-tts
tools.when_to_use: Split long chapter scripts into retryable speech segments and generate aligned SRT subtitles.
tools.notes: Uses an online speech service. Recheck voice availability, service terms, and commercial-use conditions before publication.

tools.name: imageio-ffmpeg
tools.license: BSD-2-Clause; bundled FFmpeg uses separate licenses
tools.when_to_use: Provide a cross-platform FFmpeg executable for chapter rendering and final assembly when system FFmpeg is unavailable.
tools.notes: The Python package license differs from licenses for bundled FFmpeg and codecs. Review the actual build and codec terms before commercial delivery.
